topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I found out today that Jake, my friend, hasn't been working at the tech company he's been bragging about since last year. Instead, he's been taking odd jobs here and there. My hands feel a bit clammy as I think about how to bring it up. It's not that I’m upset about him struggling, it’s more that he chose to weave a tale instead of just talking to me. I'm not sure how to approach him without making it seem like I’ve been snooping around. Maybe I'll just ask him lightly about his latest project and see where the conversation goes.
